title: Grocery delivery aisle with quantity steppers and mini-cart drawer
notes: v2 switches to atomic (StyleX-like) class names. The left aisle list becomes a horizontal department tab bar with merged/renamed departments ('Bakery' → 'Bakery & Bread') plus a hidden 'All departments' drawer repeating the links. Shelves are renamed and re-ordered (Eggs first), tiles lose ids/data-sku and are re-ordered (per-SKU data-testids collapse to a generic 'ItemCard'); 'Add' becomes 'Add to cart'; stepper buttons get product-specific labels. A 'Your usuals' rail repeats Organic Whole Milk, and a new 'Large White Eggs, 12 ct' tile has the same unit price as the brown eggs. The mini-cart moves into <gb-cart-drawer>'s shadow root with lines newest-first, icon-only remove buttons labelled per product and a 'Go to checkout' button.

targets.description: 'Add' button on the 'Organic Whole Milk, 1 gal' tile
Increase-quantity (+) button on the 'Greek Yogurt Plain, 32 oz' tile (already in cart)
Unit price label ($0.37/ct) of the 'Large Brown Eggs, 12 ct' tile
Remove (trash) icon button of the 'Sharp Cheddar Block, 8 oz' line in the mini-cart
